## create

Create Contact Token. `POST /contact-tokens`

Create a contact token for the live chat widget

Mints a short-lived, opaque token (s7ct_…) for ONE contact that is redeemable only on widget_id. Pass it to the widget as SendSevenConfig.contactToken; the chat then starts bound to that contact and AI agents receive the exposed fields and context as verified data.

```php
$result = $sendseven->contactTokens()->create(widgetId: 'widget_id', contact: []);
```

- Scopes: `contact_tokens:create`, `contacts:read`, `contacts:create`, `create_if_missing`, `contacts:update`, `external_id`, `save`, `on_conflict: "merge"`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$widgetId` | `string` | yes | Live chat widget the token is redeemable on |
| `$contact` | `array<string, mixed>` | yes |  |
| `$expose` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no |  |
| `$context` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Any JSON object (max 4 KB serialized, 30 keys) shared with the chat as verified context. Never stored on the contact. |
| `$save` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Fields written to the contact when the token is created (replaces the value). Keys: name, first_name, last_name, language, or active custom field keys. Requires contacts:update (or contacts:create for a contact created by this call). |
| `$saveIfEmpty` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Like save, but written only where the field is empty. |
| `$ttlSeconds` | `?int` | no | Redeem window in seconds (30-3600, default 600) |
| `$grantTtlSeconds` | `?int` | no | How long the context stays valid in the chat session after redeem (60-604800, default 86400) |
| `$maxRedemptions` | `?int` | no | How often the token may be redeemed (page reloads, tabs), 1-50 |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `ContactToken`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Contact%20Tokens/create_contact_token_api_v1_contact_tokens_post)

## revoke

Revoke Contact Token. `DELETE /contact-tokens/{token_id}`

Revoke a contact token

The token can no longer be redeemed and every chat session context created from it stops being used immediately. Idempotent: revoking an already revoked token succeeds.

```php
$result = $sendseven->contactTokens()->revoke(tokenId: 'token_id');
```

- Scopes: `contact_tokens:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$tokenId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `Delete`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Contact%20Tokens/revoke_contact_token_api_v1_contact_tokens__token_id__delete)

## revokeFor

Revoke Contact Tokens For Contact. `POST /contacts/{contact_id}/contact-tokens/revoke`

Revoke all contact tokens of a contact

Use it on logout or when a user's access changes. Every unrevoked token of the contact is revoked and their chat session context stops being used.

```php
$result = $sendseven->contactTokens()->revokeFor(contactId: 'contact_id');
```

- Scopes: `contact_tokens:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$contactId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `ContactTokenRevoke`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Contact%20Tokens/revoke_contact_tokens_for_contact_api_v1_contacts__contact_id__contact_tokens_revoke_post)
